prompt: Read-only classification for a newly discovered Kolibri VPS. Check OS, CPU, RAM, disk, public IP, VPN state, Mimo version/path, Python/Node/Git availability, running Kolibri services, and whether /opt/kolibri-ai exists. Do not install packages, write files, restart services, alter firewall, or reveal secrets. Return recommended role, health gates, bootstrap gaps, and whether this server is safe for agent tasks.

quality_contract.objective: Classify a newly discovered Kolibri VPS into a precise agent role with safe rollout gates.
quality_contract.context: Codex needs reliable server inventory before assigning 24/7 Mimo agents or mutation work.
scope: Collect OS, CPU, RAM, disk, public IP, VPN state, Mimo path/version, and project directory status.
Map observed capabilities to one recommended primary role.
Report bootstrap gaps and health gates needed before agent rollout.
out_of_scope: Do not install packages, write files, restart services, alter firewall, or deploy code.
Do not read secrets, auth files, .env files, .ssh, or .mimocode.
Do not assign multiple competing primary roles.
acceptance_criteria: Return one recommended server role and explain why the hardware/network state supports it.
Return whether the server is safe for read-only tasks, controlled mutation tasks, or neither.
Return exact missing prerequisites before 24/7 use.
verification_steps: Inspect OS, resources, disk, network identity, and available developer tooling.
Check Mimo version/path without exposing auth configuration.
Check Kolibri services and /opt/kolibri-ai layout if present.
deliverables: Structured result with status, summary, changed_files, checks, risks, and artifacts.
Recommended role, health gates, bootstrap gaps, and rollout readiness.
stop_conditions: Stop if the task requires credentials, tokens, private keys, or auth file contents.
Stop if classification would require modifying server state.
